desc: New 702 Plinkster Bantam scoped combo model features a shortened 12 1/4" stock and 18" barrel - perfect for young shooters or smaller stature adults. Accuracy - 18" and 20" barrels are free-floated and feature a 1 in 16" RH twist for superior accuracy. Synthetic finishes - A variety of Dura-wood, standard black, hi-definition camo, and carbon fiber finished synthetic stocks are available. Dovetailed receiver - Receiver is grooved to accept 3/8" scope mounts for quick and easy optics installation. Easy Operation - Conveniently located cross bolt safety and magazine release button. Performance - Aluminum alloy receiver and trigger guard for improved balance and handling. Detachable magazine - A 10-round capacity detachable metal magazine is included with each rifle. Sights - All 702 Plinkster models feature a fold down rear sight, allowing for mounting of 32 mm or smaller objective diameter scope.
